language.title: Language
language.hint: Changes apply immediately and are saved on this device.
language.unavailable: This language is not available yet.
language.saveFailed: Could not save your language. Try again.
language.sessionOnly: The language preference could not be restored.
updates.title: Updates
updates.none: No newer release found on this channel.
updates.notChecked: Check for a new release when you are ready.
updates.installHint: Opens the official download in your browser. Install over the current app to keep your library; do not uninstall first.
updates.autoHint: Optional. At most once a day; nothing is installed automatically.
updates.previewsHint: Also show newer test versions, which may be less reliable.
updates.privacy: Checks contact the official RITVIO repository on GitHub. No listening history or library data is sent.
updates.error.connection: Could not reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again in a moment.
updates.error.response: GitHub returned an unexpected response. Try again later.
updates.error.limited: Please wait before checking again. Recent results remain available.
updates.error.storage: Could not save or read update settings. Try again or restart the app.
updates.error.open: Could not open the browser. Try the download again.
first.title: Start with a song.
first.hint: Search for a track or artist, press play, then tap the heart to keep a favourite. Already have a playlist? Preview it before adding it.
first.libraryHint: Save a track with the heart, create a playlist, or bring in a supported playlist. Everything stays on this device.
transfer.previewHint: Preview first. Choose the tracks and destination before saving. Your music keeps playing.
transfer.linkSupport: Accessible YouTube or YouTube Music playlists: paste the full HTTPS playlist link. Public or accessible unlisted lists do not need an account.
transfer.fileSupport: RITVIO playlist files (.ritvio.json, version 1), up to 4 MB and 1,000 tracks. Export one from the other app’s Library. These files contain track references, not audio.
transfer.unsupported: Private lists, personal Mixes, Watch Later, liked-song lists and Spotify or Apple Music links are not supported.
transfer.localCopy: Imports keep the source order. Duplicate skipping compares track IDs, not titles. This is a local copy, without automatic synchronisation.
transfer.partial: The source may be incomplete. Unavailable entries were left out; they were not silently replaced. You can read the source again later and add to this playlist with duplicate skipping enabled.
transfer.playbackSafe: Your queue and current playback are unchanged. Open the playlist when you are ready.
transfer.selectedHint: Your selection keeps the original order. Unavailable entries cannot be selected.
transfer.fileShort: RITVIO file v1 · up to 4 MB / 1,000 tracks
share.imageHint: The PNG contains no clickable link. Copy the text + link to post alongside your image.
share.captionHint: Shares include a short message and song link. Some apps keep only the image; share the link separately if needed.
support.title: Help & feedback
support.hint: Something not working, or an idea to share? Start here.
support.kind: What would you like to send?
support.bugHint: Describe the steps, what you expected and what happened. Add your device and OS version in the GitHub form.
support.visualHint: Tell us which screen is hard to use or read, and what would help. For a broken control, choose a reproducible problem.
support.ideaHint: Explain the listening problem you want to solve and how you would use the proposed feature.
support.timingsHint: Optional. Reads recent timing counters on this device. Song titles, URLs and personal paths are excluded.
support.noTimings: No timings are available yet. You can still copy the app context.
support.opened: GitHub form requested. Review and submit it there.
support.privacy: Opening GitHub sends only app version and platform. Sign in there to complete and submit the form. Timings stay here until you copy and paste them.
support.error.timings: Could not read timings. Retry or continue with the app context.
support.error.copy: Could not copy the report. Select the report text and copy it, or try again.
support.error.open: Could not open GitHub. Copy the report and visit the project’s Issues page in your browser.
support.existingOpened: Existing reports requested. Browse them on GitHub.
